newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $362 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $362 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday were expected to total $362 million in 17 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $197 million in seven sales, with a $100 million Port Authority of New York & New Jersey, deal through Lehman Brothers, topping the list.

On the competitive side, 10 sales totaling $165 million are scheduled. A $40 million Kansas City, deal at 1000 EDT is the largest. An additional three sales totaling $63 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Thursday depending on market conditions.
